senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; פָּכַךְ)flask, jar with a narrow neck, v. טָפִי.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Horayot 3:2:24">Y. Hor. III, 47ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>נמשחו מן הפך</he> were anointed out of a flask, opp. <cite ref="S02101"><he>קרן</he></cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 14a:18">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Megillah 14a:18">Ib.</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="I Samuel 2:1">I Sam. II, 1</cite>) <he>רמה קרני ולא רמה פַּכִּי</he> ‘my horn is high’, but not ‘my flask is high.’ <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 3:10">Tosef. Succ. III, 10</cite> <he>כמין פי הפך</he> as if coming forth through the mouth of a flask, v. <cite ref="Q00922"><he>פִּכְפֵּךְ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 12:5">Neg. XII, 5</cite> <he>חסה התורה … ועל פַּכּוֹ</he> the Torah has regard … even for a man’s flask; Sifra M’teorʿa, <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 3">Neg., ch. III</cite>, Par. 5.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 69">Gen. R. s. 69</cite>, end <he>שופע … כמלא פי הפך</he> the oil was poured down for him from heaven in large drops as if coming out of a flask; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 120">Yalk. ib. 120</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פַּכִּים</he>, <he>פַּכִּין</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 84b:1">Sabb. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ קטנים</he> small flasks (into which you cannot dip your finger); <cite ref="Bava Kamma 25b:5">B. Kam. 25ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 91a:22">Ḥull. 91ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 32:25">Gen. XXXII, 25</cite>) <he>נשתייר על פ׳ קטנים</he> he remained behind for the sake of some small jars.
